intermediate_data_files: All 15 band, tie-point-grid, header and vector CSV files are byte-identical by SHA-256.

tests.result: Manual and probe TC outputs are exactly equal for both bands: 703,057,806 pixels per band; zero differing pixels.
tests.name: restore orbit metadata in a diagnostic copy of graph Spk DIM

tests.method: Ran Apply-Orbit-File immediately before TC using the saved graph Spk product.
tests.result: It retained orbit_state_vector_file=- and the 17 stale vectors; its TC discrepancy is identical to the uncorrected graph baseline.
tests.name: reapply Apply-Orbit-File to processed graph Spk product

conclusion: The graph Apply-Orbit-File output contains the precise vectors, but ThermalNoiseRemoval resets the downstream product source metadata to original vectors. Restoring the precise orbit metadata alone before TC makes the result bit-identical to manual TC, strongly identifying the metadata reset as the cause. Reapplying Apply-Orbit-File to the processed product does not restore it. The next pipeline fix must preserve/restore the precise orbit metadata through downstream graph processing, then be validated on both acquisition dates.
